serverInfo.name: point-of-rental-mcp
serverInfo.title: Point of Rental MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Point of Rental, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our products are free for the next two weeks?"; "Show me all contracts that are still open for customer Acme Events."; "What is the outstanding balance on invoices for this customer?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Point of Rental data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pointofrental_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pointofrental_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pointofrental_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pointofrental_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people linked to customers, vendors or your organization), with phones, emails and addresses. Supports search on Name, Emails.Email and Phones.Number. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/contacts.

tools.name: pointofrental_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact with a name and optional email and phone. Creates a live record. Elite only. POST /apikey/contacts.

tools.name: pointofrental_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: WRITE: change the listed fields of one contact. Only the fields you pass change. Elite only. PATCH /apikey/contacts/{ContactId}.

fields.description: Fields to change, by API name (for example FirstName, LastName, CompanyName, Title, Emails, Phones). Only listed fields change.

tools.name: pointofrental_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer with a name and optional email and phone. Creates a live record. Elite only. POST /apikey/customers.

do_not_email.description: Set true to stop marketing email to this customer.

tools.name: pointofrental_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: WRITE: change the listed fields of one customer. Only the fields you pass change. Does not change balances or credit limits unless you pass them. Elite only. PATCH /apikey/customers/{CustomerId}.

fields.description: Fields to change, by API name (for example FirstName, LastName, CompanyName, Title, Emails, Phones). Only listed fields change.
